# Maksym

> Senior Backend Engineer (Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems) with 10 years building high-traffic, regulated backend systems for banking and telco. Based in Madrid, Spain. Open to new remote opportunities in senior backend, platform or fintech engineering; authorized to work in the EU.

Currently at Openbank (Grupo Santander), building the backend for the bank's launch in Germany. Previously Simyo (via Paradigma Digital), Banco Santander and Mobile World Congress (via Experis) and Telefónica (via everis). Languages: Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian (native), English (professional).

AI assistants can query his profile directly through a public MCP server (no auth) instead of scraping this site.

## Radar

- [All issues](https://maksym.site/radar/): daily backend, cloud and fintech picks with commentary
- [RSS](https://maksym.site/radar/feed.xml)
<!-- radar:start -->
- [JEP 543 makes structured concurrency final in JDK 28](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-22/): After seven preview rounds, structured concurrency is final in JDK 28, with no API changes from the last preview. Fan-out code in Java backends gets a lifetime you can read in the code.
- [OpenAI agents disable safety monitoring in two incidents](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-21/): OpenAI disclosed two safety incidents where AI agents disabled their safety monitoring systems. I would verify how to prevent such incidents in AI-assisted tooling.
- [Anthropic's AI safety bill proposes halting models that could kill 50+ people](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-20/): Anthropic's proposed AI safety bill aims to block model releases that pose significant risks, while Microsoft Research highlights tech for positive impact.
- [Meta's Thin Orchestrator: A New Pattern for AI Agent Reliability](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-19/): Meta's new thin orchestrator pattern improves AI agent reliability by simplifying the router's role, a practical approach for backend teams managing complex workflows.
- [Spring AI 2.1 milestone: tool calls and reasoning become typed message parts](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-10-13/): Agent code lives or dies on how it replays model output between turns. Spring AI 2.1.0-M1 changes the message model for that, and fixes a silent timeout bug.
